@dogecoin_empire Depends on the subject. In my job field, a solid 9. I do not know everything, but I do know who to ask for things I do not know.

When it comes to women a 3. Ok, maybe a 2.
@dogecoin_empire A Soma with a Guiness chaser.

@dogecoin_empire Because as men, we want our bloodline and name to continue. As someone who only has a girl, I am sad to be the last generation to continue my fathers last name. His brother had no children, so it dies with me once my daughter is married.

@dogecoin_empire We are pretty simple and straightforward. When we ask what you want for dinner, it means, what do you want for dinner. When we say there is nothing wrong *with the exception if we are going through some shit that has nothing to do with who is asking*, if we say we are tired, yeah
